title: Résumé spec
description: The structured input to the fitcheck renderer (render.js). A projection of the achievement bank for one target: header + summary + experience (roles with bullets) + optional projects, skills, education. Inline **bold** is supported in any text field. Em dashes are forbidden and rejected at render time.

contact.description: Single line, middot-separated: 'City · email · phone · linkedin · github'.

org.description: e.g. 'Microsoft · Senior Product Manager, Active Directory · Redmond, WA'.

subline.description: Optional italic scope line under the role.

bullets.description: Each supports **bold**. Usually a chosen framing from a bank entry.
